Oath Witness

You stood beside people as they swore their promises, carrying a bright oath-blade as a reminder that some words demand more than witnesses.

Which broken promise still follows you?

Rules

Choose one:

- Influence 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1a1feaf77509de38.JournalEntryPage.0945b9e272c8f101]{Name the Reckoning}. - Radiance 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ae631c154411e4e0.JournalEntryPage.f4aff541dead2b16]{Oathlight Strike}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +10 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
